newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July crude steel output up 8.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan July crude steel output up 8.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's crude steel production rose to 8.8 million tonnes in July, up 8.4 percent from a year earlier, the Japan Iron and Steel Federation said on Monday.
July was the tenth consecutive month of year-on-year gains in Japan's crude steel output, the federation said.
Month-over-month, output was up 1.1 percent in July from June, it added.
Production of galvanised steel sheet in July rose to 1.1 million tonnes, a gain of 17.6 percent from a year earlier and up 3.7 percent month-on-month, the federation said.
July output of tin plate was 131,900 tonnes, down 8.3 percent year-on-year and down 0.2 percent month-on-month, it said.
